title: Mohsin ne kaha rokar
body:
farzande zehra ka tha ye nauha
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaze ke girne se jo phasliyan tooti hai
mai dekh raha hoo wo kis tarha tadpti hai
hai dard bhara manzar amma hai musibat mein
<<DIVIDER>>
mohsin ne kaha rokar amma hai musibat mein
pehlu pe gira hai dar amma hai musibat mein
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ko kameeno ne kuch aise rulaya hai
has has ke layeeno ne darwaza jalaya hai
dil par hai rawan khanjar amma hai musibat mein
mohsin ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaano pa layeeno ne durre bhi lagaye hai
talwar ke qabze se kuch zakhm bhi aaye hai
mehfooz nahi hai sar amma hai musibat mein
mohsin ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko bulaati hai ro ro ke meri amma
hyder ko bulaati hai mehdi ko kabhi amma
barpa hai ajab mehshar amma hai musibat mein
mohsin ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti hui seene mein ek keel chubhi hai jab
yaad aaya hai amma ko akbar ka tadapna tab
akbar ki musibat par amma hai musibat mein
mohsin ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
irfan hai amma ko meri bhi musibat ka
nasir tha mai amma ka par koi nahi mera
ek keel ke naize se beta hai musibat mein
mohsin ne kaha rokar...
author: Nasir Hussain
